chapter: Early influences, Oliver date and trombone peers
title: Tricky Sam Nanton and the hidden plunger
summary: Playing tricks on Tricky Sam, he hid his plunger mute before solos.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You're a very important person. Sam What about Tricky Simon?
I couldn't do nothing with him, but hire his plunger. He always used his plunger ... when he's playing with Duke (??). So we were playing with Luis Russell and
we were both on the stand Duke ... so we used to play tricks on each other then. So you couldn't do nothing with my big plunger and I hid it ... (?)
I gave it back to him.
Did you take his plunger before he walked in the door...
Yeah, he'd reach down (...) solo and no plunger there.
He didn't do nothing. He used his hands.
I'll bet he was going crazy trying to figure out what happened.
He sure was but he didn't get angry about it. I mean it's clean fun, doing that kind of thing.
